constraints.name: offline_admission_ck1
constraints.expression: (((durable_state = 'ISSUED'::text) AND (consumed_decision_id IS NULL) AND (consumed_at IS NULL)) OR ((durable_state = 'CONSUMED'::text) AND (consumed_decision_id IS NOT NULL) AND (consumed_at IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: offline_admission_ck2
constraints.expression: ((admission_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (deployment_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (incarnation_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (binding_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (attempt_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (execution_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (instance_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (credential_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (principal_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (organization_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (grant_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND ((consumed_decision_id IS NULL) OR (consumed_decision_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND (generation > 0) AND ((executor_oid >= 1) AND (executor_oid <= '4294967295'::bigint)) AND (credential_revision > 0) AND (grant_revision > 0) AND (lock_token = 0) AND (octet_length(authorization_fingerprint) = 32) AND (permission = 'TRANSACTION_IDENTITY_DECISION_WRITE'::text))

constraints.name: offline_admission_ck3
constraints.expression: (isfinite(authenticated_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND (authenticated_at < expires_at) AND ((consumed_at IS NULL) OR (isfinite(consumed_at) AND (authenticated_at <= consumed_at) AND (consumed_at < expires_at))))

constraints.name: offline_binding_header_ck2
constraints.expression: ((octet_length(manifest_digest) = 32) AND (octet_length(canonical_manifest_hash) = 32) AND (octet_length(deadline_policy_digest) = 32) AND (octet_length(plan_fingerprint) = 32) AND (octet_length(canonical_manifest_bytes) > 0) AND (octet_length(identity_slots) > 0) AND (manifest_digest = canonical_manifest_hash) AND (canonical_manifest_hash = sha256(canonical_manifest_bytes)) AND (offline_surface_version = '0090-v1'::text) AND (admission_contract_version = '1'::text) AND (delivery_contract_version = '1'::text) AND (reconciliation_contract_version = '1'::text) AND (permission = 'TRANSACTION_IDENTITY_DECISION_WRITE'::text) AND ((source_order_reference <> ''::text) AND (source_order_reference IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (source_order_reference !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)) AND ((integration_reference <> ''::text) AND (integration_reference IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (integration_reference !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)) AND ((reason <> ''::text) AND (reason IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (reason !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)) AND ((provenance <> ''::text) AND (provenance IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (provenance !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)) AND ((deadline_policy_version <> ''::text) AND (deadline_policy_version IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (deadline_policy_version !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)))

constraints.name: offline_binding_header_ck3
constraints.expression: (isfinite(issued_at) AND isfinite(valid_from) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND (issued_at < expires_at) AND (valid_from < expires_at))

constraints.name: offline_ceremony_result_ck1
constraints.expression: ((binding_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (((result = 'NONE'::text) AND (evidence_digest IS NULL) AND (recorded_at IS NULL)) OR ((result = ANY (ARRAY['SUCCESS'::text, 'FAILURE'::text, 'MANUAL_REVIEW'::text])) AND (evidence_digest IS NOT NULL) AND (octet_length(evidence_digest) = 32) AND (recorded_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(recorded_at))))

constraints.name: offline_delivery_ck2
constraints.expression: ((binding_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND ((attempt_id IS NULL) OR (attempt_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND ((execution_id IS NULL) OR (execution_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND ((instance_id IS NULL) OR (instance_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND ((credential_id IS NULL) OR (credential_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND ((initial_operation_id IS NULL) OR (initial_operation_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND ((fresh_applied_receipt_id IS NULL) OR (fresh_applied_receipt_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND ((delivery_receipt_id IS NULL) OR (delivery_receipt_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND (generation > 0) AND (lock_token = 0) AND (((state = 'NOT_CREATED'::text) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (execution_id IS NULL) AND (instance_id IS NULL) AND (credential_id IS NULL) AND (initial_operation_id IS NULL) AND (fresh_applied_receipt_id IS NULL)) OR ((state <> 'NOT_CREATED'::text) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (execution_id IS NOT NULL) AND (instance_id IS NOT NULL) AND (credential_id IS NOT NULL) AND (initial_operation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (fresh_applied_receipt_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: offline_delivery_ck3
constraints.expression: ((((delivery_receipt_id IS NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NULL) AND (operation_deadline IS NULL)) OR ((delivery_receipt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (operation_deadline IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(attempted_at) AND isfinite(operation_deadline) AND (attempted_at < operation_deadline))) AND (((state = ANY (ARRAY['NOT_CREATED'::text, 'CREATED_NOT_DELIVERABLE'::text])) AND (delivery_receipt_id IS NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NULL) AND (operation_deadline IS NULL) AND (observed_at IS NULL) AND (observation_code IS NULL) AND (recorded_at IS NULL)) OR ((state = ANY (ARRAY['DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED'::text, 'DELIVERY_ACKNOWLEDGED'::text, 'DELIVERY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN'::text])) AND (delivery_receipt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (operation_deadline IS NOT NULL)) OR (state = 'DELIVERY_FAILED_REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text)) AND (((observed_at IS NULL) AND (observation_code IS NULL) AND (recorded_at IS NULL)) OR ((observed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (observation_code IS NOT NULL) AND (recorded_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(observed_at) AND isfinite(recorded_at) AND (observation_code = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETE'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text, 'IO_FAILURE'::text, 'PROCESS_UNCERTAINTY'::text])))) AND ((state <> 'DELIVERY_ACKNOWLEDGED'::text) OR ((observed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (observation_code IS NOT NULL) AND (recorded_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: offline_diagnostic_evidence_ck1
constraints.expression: ((binding_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND ((attempt_id IS NULL) OR (attempt_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND (generation > 0) AND (octet_length(snapshot_digest) = 32))

constraints.name: offline_diagnostic_evidence_ck2
constraints.expression: ((classification <> ''::text) AND (classification IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (classification !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND ((recorder_identity <> ''::text) AND (recorder_identity IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (recorder_identity !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)) AND isfinite(recorded_at))

constraints.name: offline_preflight_key_ck2
constraints.expression: (((key_state = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (key_material IS NOT NULL) AND (octet_length(key_material) = 32)) OR ((key_state = 'RETIRED'::text) AND (key_material IS NULL)))

constraints.name: offline_readiness_ck2
constraints.expression: ((policy_version <> ''::text) AND (policy_version IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (policy_version !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (octet_length(policy_digest) = 32) AND (octet_length(history_manifest) > 0) AND (octet_length(acl_manifest) > 0) AND isfinite(watchdog_checked_at))

constraints.name: offline_reconciliation_ck1
constraints.expression: ((binding_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (state = ANY (ARRAY['NOT_STARTED'::text, 'REQUIRED'::text, 'IN_PROGRESS'::text, 'RECONCILED'::text, 'MISMATCH'::text, 'INDETERMINATE'::text])) AND ((evidence_digest IS NULL) OR ((octet_length(evidence_digest) = 32) AND (recorded_at IS NOT NULL))) AND ((recorded_at IS NULL) OR isfinite(recorded_at)) AND ((state <> ALL (ARRAY['RECONCILED'::text, 'MISMATCH'::text, 'INDETERMINATE'::text])) OR ((evidence_digest IS NOT NULL) AND (recorded_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: offline_stage_receipt_ck1
constraints.expression: ((binding_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (attempt_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (execution_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (instance_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND (receipt_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AND ((operation_id IS NULL) OR (operation_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) AND (generation > 0) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['ATTESTATION_VERIFIED'::text, 'PRINCIPAL_APPLIED'::text, 'INITIAL_CREDENTIAL_APPLIED'::text, 'GRANT_APPLIED'::text, 'IDENTITY_DECISION_APPLIED'::text])))

constraints.name: offline_stage_receipt_ck2
constraints.expression: ((octet_length(frozen_receipt) > 0) AND isfinite(effect_time) AND (((stage = ANY (ARRAY['ATTESTATION_VERIFIED'::text, 'IDENTITY_DECISION_APPLIED'::text])) AND (operation_id IS NULL)) OR ((stage = ANY (ARRAY['PRINCIPAL_APPLIED'::text, 'INITIAL_CREDENTIAL_APPLIED'::text, 'GRANT_APPLIED'::text])) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL))))
